TouchSensor enabled=false is the only trigger for the timer.

IntegerSequencer value 3 drives Switch with only 2 children (and routes to whichChoice, which is inputOutput).
Sequencer has keys and input but no ROUTE out.
Two interpolators drive Transform.translation simultaneously (fan-in).
ROUTE cycle between two transforms with no break.

Script has no url/source and routed outputs.

Appearance outside a Shape, as direct Scene child
USE of a Sphere DEF inside an Appearance slot (wrong type)
Duplicate DEF name A on two different shapes
coordIndex lacks -1 face terminators
coordIndex 4 is one past end of 4 points
creaseAngle 30 given in degrees (radians expected)
ElevationGrid 3x3 needs 9 heights, 8 given
Extrusion with a single spine point
transparency 1 on the only object
PhysicalMaterial roughness 2 (range 0..1)
Colour given as 255 0 0
fieldOfView 45 in degrees (radians, max <pi)
SpotLight cutOffAngle < beamWidth
rotation angle 90 written in degrees (radians expected)
scale 0 on one axis, degenerate flat box
Object 10000 km from origin
LOD range not ascending
Background skyAngle has 3 values but 2 skyColors (needs n+1=4 colours for 3 angles)
DirectionalLight direction 0 0 0
TimeSensor ROUTE source field is misspelt fraction_change instead of fraction_changed
The interpolator SFVec3f output is routed to Lamp set_rotation (SFRotation) instead of set_translation
ROUTE fromField is Leader set_translation (an inputOnly event) instead of translation_changed
TimeSensor has loop=false with a startTime long in the past, though the pulse is meant to repeat forever
ROUTE toNode is door but the node is DEF Door (case mismatch)
PositionInterpolator has three keys but only two keyValue triples
ScalarInterpolator key list 0 0.8 0.5 is not non-decreasing (should be 0 0.5 1)
TouchSensor sits in a different Group from the sphere, so it is not a sibling of the geometry it should sense
PlaneSensor minPosition 2 0 and maxPosition 0 0 are swapped (min greater than max leaves x unconstrained)
The clock is left enabled (default) so the spinner runs from load, though it should wait for the first click
PositionDamper tau is 0 (no smoothing) instead of 0.5
ProximitySensor size is 0 0 0 (disabled) instead of 30 30 30
The Wall Shape is a sibling of the Collision node instead of its child
StringSensor enteredText is routed to the label instead of finalText
IntegerSequencer last keyValue is 3 but the Switch has only choices 0..2
Script handler function is named onTick but the inputOnly field is named tick, so it is never called
The Closeup Viewpoint is listed before Overview, so Closeup is bound at load
The watched Inline has load=false so it never loads and LoadSensor never reports isLoaded
Anchor url fragment is #Closeup but the Viewpoint is DEF CloseUp (case mismatch)
LOD range is 20 5 (decreasing) instead of 5 20
One face of the indexed face set references vertex index 8 but only vertices 0 to 7 exist.
LOD range has three entries for three children; it must have one fewer entry than children.
ccw is set to false although the faces are wound counter-clockwise seen from outside.
Six per-face normals are supplied while normalPerVertex is true and there are eight vertices.
Colour components are written on a 0 to 255 scale instead of 0 to 1.
The ProtoInstance sets a field called towerColour but the prototype declares towerColor.
The TextureCoordinate holds three points for a four-vertex face.
The cross-section points are ordered so the outline crosses itself (a bow-tie) instead of tracing the square.
height lists 11 values but xDimension times zDimension is 12.
The uKnot vector has six values but uDimension plus uOrder needs seven.
The scene uses a NURBS node but neither the profile nor a component statement provides the NURBS component.
USE refers to wheel but the node was defined as Wheel; names are case sensitive.
The blue ball reuses the DEF name RedPost, so the later USE resolves to the ball.
Material is placed directly in Shape instead of inside Appearance.
The rotation angle is written as 90, which X3D reads as ninety radians.
fieldOfView is given as 60 (degrees) but is in radians and must be in (0, pi).
The headlight is switched off and the scene has no other light, so the lit sphere is unlit.
whichChoice is 3, counted from one, but choices are indexed from zero so index 3 selects nothing.
shininess is 50 where the legal range is 0 to 1.
The DirectionalLight direction is the zero vector.
The size animation uses a ScalarInterpolator, so an SFFloat value_changed is routed to Transform.set_scale, which is SFVec3f.
The grow animation is routed to Box.size, an initializeOnly field that cannot receive events, instead of to the enclosing Transform's scale.
The TimeSensor that should run forever has no loop='true'; with the default startTime of 0 and loop FALSE it never becomes active.
cycleInterval is written in milliseconds (500) although the field is in seconds, so one flash takes 500 s instead of 0.5 s.
The PositionInterpolator has four keys but only three keyValues; the second 'top' position that makes the platform wait is missing.

The full turn is given as two keys, angle 0 and angle 6.2832 about the same axis; these are the same orientation, and an OrientationInterpolator takes the shortest path between them, which is no motion.
Both TimeSensors carry the same DEF name (copy-paste); the ROUTEs at the end both resolve to one of them, so both lanterns share one clock.
The first ROUTE names fromNode='DoorTimer', but no node has that DEF; the clock is called DoorClock.
The scene declares profile Immersive only, but uses a ColorChaser, which belongs to the Followers component that Immersive does not include; the component statement is missing.
The first ROUTE uses fromField='fraction'; TimeSensor has no such field, the output is fraction_changed.
The IntegerSequencer counts 1, 2, 3 while the Switch children are numbered 0, 1, 2.
The TouchSensor sits among the floor's children instead of beside the button's geometry, so it senses the floor and not the button.
The PlaneSensor's trackPoint_changed is routed to the puck instead of translation_changed, so the puck's centre is put at the pointer's hit point instead of moving by the drag distance.
The ProximitySensor has no size, and the default size 0 0 0 disables the sensor.
The script compares actionKeyPress against browser DOM key codes (39 and 37); the X3D action-key codes for right and left arrow are 20 and 19.
The script's function is named clicked, but the input field is named set_clicked; a Script handler must have exactly the field's name, so it is never called.
TouchSensor.isActive sends TRUE on press and FALSE on release, and the script flips its state on every event without looking at the value, so each click flips the lamp twice.
Both PositionInterpolators are routed to the same inner Transform's translation in the same timestamp, so one overwrites the other; the crossing should drive the outer BeePath Transform.
The target position is routed to the damper's set_value, which sets the output immediately, instead of to set_destination, which it would glide towards.
TouchSensor.isActive is routed straight to Viewpoint.set_bind, so the FALSE sent on release unbinds the close-up viewpoint again.
Material is placed directly inside Shape instead of inside an Appearance node.
Two Transform USE elements carry their own translation attributes, as if USE made an editable copy; a USE is the same node and other attributes are ignored.
USE='brassLook' does not match the declared DEF='BrassLook' (names are case sensitive), so the reference dangles.
coordIndex is written 1-based: every index is one too high, so index 6 is out of range for the six coordinates and every face uses the wrong corners.
The lid face is listed clockwise (3 7 6 2) while all other faces are counter-clockwise, with ccw and solid at TRUE, so the lid is back-face culled and its normal points inward.
Five colours are meant one per face, but colorPerVertex is left at its default TRUE, so the five colours are applied to the five vertices and blended across faces.
The Extrusion crossSection is not closed (the first point is not repeated at the end), so only three of the four side walls are generated.
xDimension and zDimension are swapped (3 and 5 instead of 5 and 3) while the 15 heights are laid out as 3 rows of 5, so the heights are re-read as 5 rows of 3.
The rotation angle is given in degrees (-90) but SFRotation angles are radians; -90 rad is about a 117 degree turn the other way round.
diffuseColor is written on a 0-255 scale (255 128 0); colour components must be in 0..1.
transparency='1' was written where full opacity was meant (transparency is the inverse of opacity/alpha), making the ball completely invisible.
TextureTransform scale='0.25 0.25' was used to repeat the tile four times; the transform acts on texture coordinates, so 0.25 magnifies the image fourfold and 4 is needed to repeat it.
DirectionalLight direction='0 1 0' was written as if it were the place the light comes from; direction is the way the light travels, so the sun shines upward from below.
The camera is moved to z=-8 behind the statue but keeps the default orientation, which looks along -Z, away from the statue.
whichChoice='2' was used for the second child; choices are numbered from 0, so 2 is out of range for two children and nothing is chosen.
The Inline url says support_bracket.x3d (underscore) but the file is support-bracket.x3d (hyphen), so the reference cannot be resolved.
The scene uses a NURBS surface node under profile Immersive without a <component name='NURBS' level='1'/> statement; Immersive does not include the NURBS component.
The first ProtoInstance sets fieldValue name='color', but the prototype interface declares the field as 'pillarColor'; the value is discarded and the default grey is used.
The third entry of the MetadataSet has containerField='metadata' instead of 'value', so priceEUR becomes metadata about the set itself rather than one of its payload entries.
The door Transform rotates about its own origin (the middle of the leaf) because no center is given for the hinge edge.
